sentences.l2: 每年深秋，单位都会为全体员工安排一次免费的年度体检。
sentences.l1: Every year in late autumn, the company arranges a free annual physical examination for all employees.

sentences.l2: 这项制度看似寻常，实则体现了一种朴素的关怀：与其等到病痛袭来才四处求医，不如在身体尚未拉响警报之时，主动去了解它真实的状况。
sentences.l1: This system seems ordinary, but in fact reflects a simple kind of care: rather than waiting until illness strikes to seek treatment everywhere, it is better to take the initiative to learn the true condition of the body before it has sounded the alarm.

sentences.l2: 体检当天，走廊里排起长队，同事们低声交谈，气氛轻松得近乎一场集体出游。
sentences.l1: On examination day, long queues form in the corridors, colleagues talk in low voices, and the atmosphere is relaxed, almost like a group outing.

sentences.l2: 抽血、拍片、测心电图，各项检查依次进行，前后不过两个小时。
sentences.l1: Blood draws, X-rays and electrocardiograms, the various examinations proceed one after another, taking no more than two hours in all.

sentences.l2: 两周之后，报告陆续发到每个人手中。
sentences.l1: Two weeks later, the reports are handed out to everyone one after another.

sentences.l2: 多数人各项指标平稳，只是被提醒少熬夜、多走动；也有少数人被告知某项指标偏高，需要尽快到专科医院复查。
sentences.l1: Most people's indicators are stable, and they are only reminded to stay up less late and walk around more; a few people are also told that a certain indicator is high and that they need to go to a specialist hospital for a recheck as soon as possible.

sentences.l2: 一位临近退休的老同事感慨，年轻时总觉得体检是可有可无的形式，如今才明白，那些密密麻麻的数字里，藏着身体最诚实的语言。
sentences.l1: An older colleague nearing retirement remarked that when he was young he always felt a physical examination was an optional formality, and only now understands that within those dense numbers lies the most honest language of the body.

sentences.l2: 习惯忽略它的人，往往要在往后付出更为沉重的代价。
sentences.l1: Those who habitually ignore it often have to pay a much heavier price later on.
